create_multimodal_embedder: create a Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder with audio and text config to project audio features to text model space
build_audio_embedding_pipeline: build an audio embedding pipeline using Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder with RMSNorm and Linear projection layers
run_forward_pass_soft: run the forward pass of Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder with soft embeddings from a conformer encoder
run_forward_pass_hard: run the forward pass of Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder with hard audio token IDs for embedding lookup
review_embedding_projection: review the Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder embedding projection that maps audio hidden size 1536 to text model dim 2048
